items: [Storage with Farmhouse Style] Elevate your storage game with this remarkable storage cabinet! The 4-door rustic white and honey brown cabinet adds a farmhouse flair to your home while offering ample storage space

[Flexible Storage for All Your Needs] This charming sideboard features 2 shelves that can be adjusted to 5 different positions, spaced 2.5" apart. You can easily store items of various sizes and keep your belongings organized

[Hidden Cables for a Tidy Space] The buffet cabinet comes with 4 cable holes on the back, allowing cords to pass through and stay out of sight. You can even place a TV up to 65" on the stand without cables detracting from your home's aesthetic appeal
[Elevated Design for Easy Cleaning] The buffet cabinet stands on 4 tall legs, raising it 3.9" off the floor. This not only enhances its charming appearance but also makes cleaning underneath a breeze

[Anti-Tip Kit Included] Keep your storage cabinet secure with the provided anti-tip kit. It can be easily attached to the wall, providing stability and creating a safer living space for you and your loved ones
